verdict.rationale: Bevy is code-first: a project is a normal Rust/cargo project, and the workflow needs no editor, so the core project format is plain source that works naturally with version control. Its Scene system can save and load ECS worlds, but the evidence never says the scene format is text, diffable or mergeable, and nothing mentions built-in collaboration. missing for 10: documented text/diffable scene serialization format, evidence of mergeable scenes or merge tooling, built-in multi-user collaboration features, hands-on corroboration of team/VCS workflows.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration

citations.quote: Bevy is just a normal Rust dependency. You can either add it to an existing Rust project or create a new one.
Create, save, and load ECS worlds using Bevy's Scene system
the code-first cargo workflow needs no editor for an agent to drive
